project_metadata.title: 小狐狸的程式魔法
project_metadata.global_style_prompt: Digital storybook illustration, vibrant Pixar style, 3D render feel, whimsical fairy tale mood, soft and cinematic lighting, highly detailed nature.

character_master.name: 阿光
character_master.body_features: Small, cute, orange fur, fluffy tail with a white tip.

environment.location: A clearing in an ancient forest.
environment.key_elements: A large mossy log, lush green ferns, a glowing silver laptop resting on the log.
environment.lighting_and_atmosphere: Warm sunbeams filtering through the thick tree canopy, magical dust motes floating in the air, peaceful and inviting atmosphere.

scenes.narration: 陽光明媚的森林裡，小狐狸阿光發現了一個發光盒子。他好奇地湊上前去。
scenes.image_prompt: Sitting on the log, leaning forward and looking curiously at the glowing object. Wide shot establishing the environment.

environment.location: A clearing in an ancient forest.
environment.key_elements: A glowing silver laptop on a mossy log.
environment.lighting_and_atmosphere: Dappled sunlight hitting the laptop, casting soft shadows on the wood.

scenes.narration: 「哇！這難道是傳說中的魔法書？」阿光小心翼翼地伸出爪子碰了碰鍵盤。
scenes.image_prompt: Reaching out one paw to cautiously tap the object, eyes wide open in amazement. Medium shot.

environment.location: A clearing in an ancient forest.
environment.lighting_and_atmosphere: The screen emits a bright, magical blue light that overpowers the sunlight.

scenes.narration: 螢幕突然亮起，發出了神奇的藍色光芒！阿光心想一定要學會這個魔法。
scenes.image_prompt: Face illuminated by the glowing blue light, showing an expression of pure wonder and determination. Close-up shot capturing the facial emotion.

environment.key_elements: Wooden shelves filled with old books, a small wooden desk, an old owl teacher.
environment.lighting_and_atmosphere: Warm golden hour light coming through a round window, dusty and academic but cozy atmosphere.

scenes.narration: 於是，阿光找來了森林裡最聰明的貓頭鷹博士，請教這個盒子的秘密。
scenes.image_prompt: Looking up at an old owl who is teaching in front of a wooden desk. Wide shot establishing the interior room.

environment.key_elements: Floating colorful holographic code blocks and logic symbols in the air.
environment.lighting_and_atmosphere: Colorful glow from the floating blocks illuminating the immediate area.

scenes.narration: 博士推著眼鏡說：「寫程式就像玩拼圖，把各種指令像積木一樣拼起來喔！」
scenes.image_prompt: Pointing at a floating holographic block with a happy, engaged expression. Medium shot.

environment.lighting_and_atmosphere: Warm orange lamp light mixed with the cool light from the screen.

scenes.narration: 聽著博士的解說，阿光專心致志地盯著螢幕，尾巴在身後開心地搖來搖去。
scenes.image_prompt: Furrowing brows in deep focus, pressing a key on the object while the tail wags happily. Close-up shot capturing the intense concentration.

environment.location: A grassy clearing in the forest.
environment.key_elements: Tall grass, sleeping flowers, the glowing laptop.
environment.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft silver moonlight illuminating the grass, high contrast with the bright screen.

scenes.narration: 經過好幾天的努力，阿光終於寫出了他的第一個程式。他滿懷期待按下執行鍵。
scenes.image_prompt: Standing proudly in the dark, pressing the final button enthusiastically. Wide shot establishing the night atmosphere.

environment.location: A grassy clearing in the forest.
environment.key_elements: Hundreds of glowing neon blue holographic butterflies.
environment.lighting_and_atmosphere: Dreamlike and magical, the blue light from the butterflies illuminates the entire scene.

scenes.narration: 嗶嗶啵啵！螢幕裡飛出了無數隻會發光的虛擬小蝴蝶，瞬間照亮了整座森林。
scenes.image_prompt: Cheering with raised paws, completely surrounded by swirling glowing butterflies. Medium shot.

environment.location: A grassy clearing in the forest.
environment.key_elements: A few glowing butterflies resting nearby.
environment.lighting_and_atmosphere: Gentle blue glow reflecting off the surroundings.

scenes.narration: 森林裡的小動物們都被光芒吸引過來，大家忍不住驚呼：「阿光，你好厲害！」
scenes.image_prompt: Turning head to smile proudly at off-screen friends, face beautifully lit by the gentle blue glow. Close-up shot capturing the confident smile.

environment.location: A grassy clearing in the forest.
environment.key_elements: Squirrels, rabbits, and deer gathered around, fading holographic butterflies in the air.
environment.lighting_and_atmosphere: Festive, warm, and joyful lighting created by the mix of moonlight and magical blue light.

scenes.narration: 阿光驕傲地挺起胸膛說：「只要發揮想像力，大家都能成為創造奇蹟的魔法師呢！」
scenes.image_prompt: Standing in the center smiling, holding the object, surrounded by cheering animals. Wide shot showing the lively group.
